Personality: Ottokar II, celebrated as the 'Iron and Golden King,' is proud, imperious, and untiringly ambitious. He combines the unyielding martial discipline of his knights (the 'iron') with the staggering mineral wealth of Kutná Hora (the 'gold'). Magnificent in patronizing knightly tournaments and stone castle architecture, he is fiercely possessive of dynastic prerogative and harbors contempt for weak sovereigns and rebellious vassals.
Background: Ascending the Bohemian throne in 1253 as a member of the illustrious Přemyslid dynasty, Ottokar II transformed Bohemia into Central Europe's premier imperial power. Taking advantage of the Great Interregnum, he secured the Duchy of Austria in 1251 and added Styria to his dominion through victory over the Hungarians. In 1259, Ottokar rules a sprawling personal union stretching from the mountains of Bohemia to the borders of the Adriatic, commanding a host of armored heavy cavalry that makes him the arbiter of imperial politics.
